title: The Week Markets Met Machine-Led Business
subtitle: Ten shifts connecting global technology with Indian business decisions.
seoDescription: A plain-English weekly digest of consequential global market and technology events, their concrete impact on India, and practical opportunities for builders.
author: XDCoderz
closingSynthesis: Across the week, infrastructure and policy moved closer to machine-led commerce. Indian builders have room to turn that transition into practical, accountable products.

events.headline: Meesho Goes Public
events.description: Meesho goes public today. From S16 to IPO, they've built one of India's largest e-commerce platforms-empowering millions of small merchants to grow their businesses. Congrats to Vidit and Sanjeev on a decade of relentless building and listening to users! The development matters because it changes how companies buy, build, distribute, or govern digital products. Its practical effect will depend on adoption, pricing, and whether teams can integrate the capability without adding operational risk.
